intro.fr: Another Crab's Treasure se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Another Crab's Treasure can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Automagic00/ACT-AP-Client-Plugin, qui héberge l'APWorld de Another Crab's Treasure.
text.en: The GitHub repository Automagic00/ACT-AP-Client-Plugin, home of the Another Crab's Treasure APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 0.5.3, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (18 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.5.3 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (18 versions released).

text.fr: Another Crab's Treasure figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Another Crab's Treasure is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
